title: Robert Saleh: Cam Ward made a bad decision, but he isn't reckless

sources.name: Pro Football Talk
sources.title: Robert Saleh: Cam Ward made a bad decision, but he isn't reckless
sources.description: After quarterback Cam Ward threw an interception in the end zone late in the fourth quarter of Sunday's 12-7 loss to the Giants, Titans head coach Robert Saleh said that Ward has "to be smarter with the football."
